title: Return of the Protection Fee: Terms of the Keyturn Guest Protection Plan Levels
content:
Three terms govern what comes back to a guest on a Keyturn Guest Protection Plan election, and all three
are written into the level. The refund window is the period after the guest elected within which the protection
fee is fully refundable, counted in whole elapsed hours from the moment the level was chosen. Proration states
whether the unused part of the fee is refundable where the trip is shortened. The cancellation percentage is
the share of the protection fee returned where the trip is cancelled.

| Protection level | Refund window after electing (hours) | Unused days refundable on a shortened trip | Protection fee returned on a cancelled trip (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Declined Protection | 0 | no | 100 |
| Keyturn Minimum Protection | 24 | no | 100 |
| Keyturn Standard Protection | 24 | yes | 100 |
| Keyturn Advantage Protection | 48 | yes | 100 |
| Keyturn Premier Protection | 48 | yes | 100 |
| Keyturn Business Traveler Protection | 72 | yes | 100 |

## The terms restated level by level

A guest on Keyturn Declined Protection has no refund window at all, since the window recorded is nil hours, and
no unused part of a fee is refundable to them on a shortened trip. A guest on Keyturn Minimum Protection has 24
hours after electing and no proration. Keyturn Standard Protection carries the same 24-hour window with
proration open; Keyturn Advantage Protection and Keyturn Premier Protection carry 48 hours with proration open;
and Keyturn Business Traveler Protection carries the longest window, 72 hours, with proration open. On every
one of the six levels a cancelled trip returns 100 percent of the protection fee.

## Boundary cases on hypothetical clocks

Take a hypothetical election made on a level whose refund window is 48 hours. A change of mind lodged when 48
whole hours have elapsed since the level was chosen falls on the boundary day of the window and is inside it; a
change of mind lodged when 49 whole hours have elapsed is outside it. On a level whose window is nil hours,
there is no elapsed time at which a change of mind falls inside the window.
